message.content: {"rules":["Implementors of `TrustedRandomAccess` must ensure that the iterator's `size_hint` is exact.","Implementors of `TrustedRandomAccess` must ensure that the iterator's `size_hint` is cheap to call.","Implementors of `TrustedRandomAccess` must not override `TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size`.","All subtypes and all supertypes of a type implementing `TrustedRandomAccess` must also implement `TrustedRandomAccess`. In particular, implementations for types with non-invariant parameters usually cannot depend on trait bounds on those parameters, except bounds from the struct or enum definition itself or bounds involving traits with a similar guarantee.","If `Self: ExactSizeIterator`, implementors of `TrustedRandomAccess` must ensure that `self.len()` always produces results consistent with `self.size()`.","For `Self: Iterator`, implementors of `TrustedRandomAccess` must make `<Self as Iterator>::__iterator_get_unchecked(&mut self, idx)` safe when all of these conditions hold: `0 <= idx < self.size()`; if `Self: !Clone`, the same index is never requested more than once; after the indexed call, `next_back()` is called at most `self.size() - idx - 1` times; after the indexed call, only `Clone::clone`, `Iterator::size_hint`, `DoubleEndedIterator::next_back`, `ExactSizeIterator::len`, `Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked`, and `TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size` are called on `self` or new clones. For `Self: Clone`, the `next_back()` limit is calculated separately for each clone, but calls before cloning count for both branches. Subtype-to-supertype coercions, including multiple steps, are permitted; after an indexed call, their resulting values are subject to the same method restriction, and indexed-call and `next_back()` counts are accumulated across each coercion chain.","When calling `Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked` on a `TrustedRandomAccess` iterator, the caller must supply an index satisfying `0 <= idx < self.size()` to obtain the trait's safety guarantees.","If a `TrustedRandomAccess` iterator is not `Clone`, callers relying on its unchecked-access safety guarantee must not call `Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked` with the same index more than once. Calls on values obtained through subtype-to-supertype coercions, including multiple coercion steps, count together with calls on the original value.","After calling `self.__iterator_get_unchecked(idx)` on a `TrustedRandomAccess` iterator, callers relying on its safety guarantees must call `next_back()` at most `self.size() - idx - 1` times. For a cloneable iterator, this limit is calculated separately for the original and each clone, but `next_back()` calls before cloning count for both. Counts on values obtained through subtype-to-supertype coercions, including multiple steps, are added to the counts for their originating value.","After calling `self.__iterator_get_unchecked(idx)` on a `TrustedRandomAccess` iterator, callers relying on its safety guarantees may call only `Clone::clone`, `Iterator::size_hint`, `DoubleEndedIterator::next_back`, `ExactSizeIterator::len`, `Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked`, and `TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size` on `self` or any new clones. The same restriction applies to values obtained by subsequent subtype-to-supertype coercions, including multiple steps.","A call to `Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked` on a `TrustedRandomAccess` iterator must not change the value returned by `size_hint`, provided that the index satisfies `0 <= idx < self.size()`; a non-`Clone` iterator never receives the same index twice; after the indexed call, at most `self.size() - idx - 1` calls to `next_back()` occur; and subsequent method calls on the iterator or new clones are limited to `Clone::clone`, `Iterator::size_hint`, `DoubleEndedIterator::next_back`, `ExactSizeIterator::len`, `Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked`, and `TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size`. For cloneable iterators, the `next_back()` limit is separate for each clone, with pre-cloning calls counting for both. Subtype-to-supertype coercions may occur repeatedly; their results retain the method restriction, and indexed-call and `next_back()` counts accumulate across each coercion chain.","After a call to `Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked` on a `TrustedRandomAccess` iterator, it must remain safe to call `Clone::clone`, `Iterator::size_hint`, `DoubleEndedIterator::next_back`, `ExactSizeIterator::len`, `Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked`, and `TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size`, assuming their required traits are implemented, provided that every unchecked index satisfies `0 <= idx < self.size()`; a non-`Clone` iterator never receives the same index twice; after each indexed call, at most `self.size() - idx - 1` calls to `next_back()` occur; and no other methods are called on the iterator or new clones after unchecked access. For cloneable iterators, the `next_back()` limit is separate for each clone, with pre-cloning calls counting for both. Subtype-to-supertype coercions may occur repeatedly; their results retain the method restriction, and indexed-call and `next_back()` counts accumulate across each coercion chain.","After a call to `Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked` on a `TrustedRandomAccess` iterator, dropping the iterator must remain safe, provided that every unchecked index satisfies `0 <= idx < self.size()`; a non-`Clone` iterator never receives the same index twice; after each indexed call, at most `self.size() - idx - 1` calls to `next_back()` occur; and subsequent method calls on the iterator or new clones are limited to `Clone::clone`, `Iterator::size_hint`, `DoubleEndedIterator::next_back`, `ExactSizeIterator::len`, `Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked`, and `TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size`. For cloneable iterators, the `next_back()` limit is separate for each clone, with pre-cloning calls counting for both. Subtype-to-supertype coercions may occur repeatedly; their results retain the method restriction, and indexed-call and `next_back()` counts accumulate across each coercion chain.","If a `TrustedRandomAccess` iterator's type `Self` is a subtype of `T`, coercing the iterator to `T` is permitted and must be safe, including after unchecked indexed access, provided that every unchecked index satisfies `0 <= idx < self.size()`; a non-`Clone` iterator never receives the same index twice; after each indexed call, at most `self.size() - idx - 1` calls to `next_back()` occur; and subsequent method calls on the iterator, new clones, or coercion results are limited to `Clone::clone`, `Iterator::size_hint`, `DoubleEndedIterator::next_back`, `ExactSizeIterator::len`, `Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked`, and `TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size`. Multiple coercion steps are permitted. Indexed-call and `next_back()` counts accumulate across each coercion chain. For cloneable iterators, the `next_back()` limit is separate for each clone, with pre-cloning calls counting for both."]}
